title: PUBLIC MEGASTRUCTURE BLUEPRINTS
description: Players can now publish fortress, farm, and racetrack blueprints directly to the world map, where visitors can tour them, rate them, and accidentally make the creator famous.
consequence: The sandbox gets landmarks worth visiting. Marketing discovers unpaid urban planning.

title: PRIVATE HARVEST FESTIVAL
description: Farm events now generate small invite-only festivals for neighbors already in the player’s valley, with shared cooking tables, crop judging, and no global announcement feed.
consequence: The valley gets warmer. The growth dashboard gets less to brag about.

title: MANDATORY RIVAL CAM
description: Extraction deaths now cut to a sponsored rival squad still inside the zone, complete with loadout tags, follow prompts, and a countdown to their next firefight.
consequence: Defeat gets louder. The audience gets somewhere else to click.

title: GUILD HALL PERMIT OFFICE
description: New guild halls now require a notarized build permit, three officer signatures, zoning approval from the nearest mayor NPC, and a linked social account before construction can begin.
consequence: The fantasy becomes municipal. The share prompt is locked behind zoning compliance.
